# Copilot instructions

The full rules for AI assistants on this project are in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the
repository root — follow them, including the checks in `AGENTS.md §3` that must pass before work
is done, and the **AI disclosure** the PR template requires (`AI_POLICY.md`). Copilot in VS Code
can read `AGENTS.md` directly, so keep rules out of this file instead of repeating them: a
summary here is loaded alongside `AGENTS.md` in every session and paid for twice.
